note: Semantic Views provides two Views plugins: the style plugin 'semanticviews_style' (Semantic Views Style) and the row plugin 'semanticviews_row' (Semantic Views Row), which control the HTML element type + attributes of a view's wrapper/list/rows/fields from the Views UI. Attributes use a one-per-line 'attribute|value' syntax; values are token-replaced and support {{ row_index }}. Settings live in the view display's style/row options (schemas views.style.semanticviews_style, views.row.semanticviews_row). No config/routes/permissions/Drush; requires core views. Medium cases create a namespaced view configured with the style plugin and read back a distinctive option (row element_type / list element_type). Hard cases switch a view's style to semanticviews_style (with row element article) / its row plugin to semanticviews_row, verified against the live view config; reset creates the view with the core default style/row so verify fails on empty state.

evals.prompt: What two Views plugins does the Semantic Views module provide, and what are they for?
evals.expected_output: A style plugin 'semanticviews_style' (Semantic Views Style, replaces Unformatted list) and a row plugin 'semanticviews_row' (Semantic Views Row). They let you set the HTML element type and attributes for the view's wrapper/list/rows and per field from the Views UI.

evals.prompt: In Semantic Views, how do you enter HTML attributes for an element in the plugin settings, and how do you insert the current row number into an attribute value?
evals.expected_output: Enter one attribute per line in the format attribute|value (a bare line becomes both key and value). Values are token-replaced; use the {{ row_index }} token for the row's 0-based index.

evals.prompt: Using Semantic Views Style, how do I output a view as a real HTML unordered list (ul/li)?
evals.expected_output: Set the List element type to 'ul' (or ol/dl) and set the Row element type to 'li' so each row is a list item inside the list wrapper.

evals.prompt: The view 'sv_eval_style' on this site uses the Semantic Views Style. Inspect its configuration and tell me which HTML element each row is wrapped in.
evals.expected_output: Each row is wrapped in an <article> element: views.view.sv_eval_style default display -> display_options.style.options.row.element_type = article.

evals.prompt: Inspect the view 'sv_eval_list' on this site (which uses Semantic Views Style) and state what HTML list element its rows are wrapped in.
evals.expected_output: An ordered list <ol>: style.options.list.element_type = ol (with row element_type li).

evals.prompt: The view 'sv_eval_task' currently uses the default 'Unformatted list' style. Change its default display to use the Semantic Views Style, and configure it so each row is wrapped in an <article> element. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: views.view.sv_eval_task default display uses style type 'semanticviews_style' with options.row.element_type = 'article'. Set the display's style plugin to semanticviews_style and its row element_type to article, then save the view.

evals.prompt: The view 'sv_eval_rowtask' uses the Semantic Views Style but the default 'Fields' row plugin. Switch its default display's row plugin to the Semantic Views Row plugin so field markup can be controlled. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: views.view.sv_eval_rowtask default display uses row type 'semanticviews_row'. Set the display's row plugin to semanticviews_row and save the view.
